THE THINKING BEHIND THE ANALYSIS

Methodology & Sources

01

Structure meets feedback

The five forces explain competitive pressures. The cycles show how those pressures may influence growth over time.

02

Read the signs

“+” means the next variable moves in the same direction; “−” means the opposite, all else equal. Neither means good or bad. “∥” indicates a delay.

03

Use judgment, then evidence

Reinforcing and balancing describe loop polarity. They do not guarantee growth or stability. Validate assumptions against the business context.
